abertura: When I was a kid, I thought this is what adulthood would look like. Imagine my disappointment.
transcricao: When I was a kid, I thought this is what adulthood would look like. Imagine my disappointment. I thought I was going to be pulling up to some exclusive elite events and that this was going to be my date. We're talking penthouse in the city, just living in luxury. Anyways, now I live in my parents' basement. Nice.

abertura: These are some of the most devastating quotes in the history of literature. There are decades where nothing happens and there are weeks when decades happen.
transcricao: These are some of the most devastating quotes in the history of literature. There are decades where nothing happens and there are weeks when decades happen. Are we what we do with time or are we what time does with us? Mahmoud Darwish. The more you understand this world, the more you destroy yourself. That's why fools are happy and intelligent people live in loneliness. And yet, the only exciting life is the imaginary one. Virginia Woolf. I am a victim of my own conscience, constantly feeling guilty for things I have not done. Franz Kafka. And lastly, how many years does it take to forget a minute?

abertura: Are you really so complex that a walk couldn't fix you? Are you just so intelligent that going outside, smelling the fresh air and exercising wouldn't be worth your time?
transcricao: Are you really so complex that a walk couldn't fix you? Are you just so intelligent that going outside, smelling the fresh air and exercising wouldn't be worth your time? There's a reason why Nietzsche said, never trust a thought that occurs to you indoors. Nikola Tesla is known to have had some of his most genius ideas come from when he was walking outside for hours at a time. In a letter to a severely depressed woman, Soren Kierkegaard said that you must maintain the ability to walk, that above all else, you must continue to walk. So why are you above all that?

abertura: There really is no life that's better than yours. As cliche as it is, sometimes it takes tragedy to remind us that fact. We're talking about an actor that had fame, money, success on the biggest TV show of all time, and he still had struggles like everyone else.
transcricao: There really is no life that's better than yours. As cliche as it is, sometimes it takes tragedy to remind us that fact. We're talking about an actor that had fame, money, success on the biggest TV show of all time, and he still had struggles like everyone else. Seemingly worse struggles than most people, right? So stop looking at other people that you see online or even that you know in person and wish that you could switch places with them. It took me a while to accept this, but I wouldn't want to be anyone else. I love being me and you should love being you, even with all the struggle and all the adversity and things that you're going through. Learn to love the journey, man. The journey is a gift and you need to have gratitude for it.

People loathe, they resent anyone who's better than them, especially when that person is getting recognition. The one thing people love more than a hero is to see a hero fail, fall, die trying. And I would go as far as to say most people don't care about evil, they just get outraged about it because it's an opportunity for them to farm superiority.
